About Channel 10

The City of Detroit's Channel 10 features programming that keeps residents informed about Detroit's latest news. Watch City Council meetings live, and catch up on the Mayor's community meetings. A note regarding meetings older than January 1, 2023; All meetings older than Jan 1 2023 have been archived. These meetings are still available to the public. To request a specific meeting please email: CityClerkHelpDesk@detroitmi.gov
